title: What to Do with the Remainder

steps.body: The same remainder answers different questions differently. Six full vans with five hikers left over means seven vans are needed — the leftover still has to travel.
steps.narration: The same remainder answers different questions differently. Six full vans with five hikers left over means seven vans are needed — the leftover still has to travel.

widget.prompt: 53 hikers, vans of 8. Hop by eights to see how many FULL vans fill.

commonLandings.feedback: Seven hops pass 53; only six vans fill completely.
Five hops leave thirteen waiting, which is more than one vanful.

widget.missFeedback: Each hop is 10. From 430, 3 hops land on 460.
widget.successFeedback: 48 after six hops — six full vans, and five hikers still waiting for a seventh.

predict.prompt: 53 hikers, vans of 8, everyone must ride. How many vans?
predict.reveal: Six vans carry 48 and leave five behind — those five need a seventh van, even a mostly empty one.

cml.actionGoal: Split a factor into places, build each piece, and reassemble the whole for g4m interpret remainder.
invariants: Splitting a factor never changes the product: every piece of the split multiplies the other factor, and the pieces add back to exactly the same total, which is what makes g4m interpret remainder decomposable at all.
misconceptions: Adding only some of the partial products, dropping or inventing a zero when factors carry tens, or letting a remainder reach or exceed the divisor.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If one partial product were left out, exactly how much of the total would go missing?

widget.prompt: 120 hikers ride vans holding 9 each. How many vans are needed?

commonErrors.feedback: 13 full vans leave 3 hikers standing — this question needs everyone carried.
3 is the leftover group of hikers, not the number of vans.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Split a factor into its places, multiply each part, and add every piece back.

widget.prompt: 53 pencils are shared into packs of 8. The answer 6 R 5 can mean different things. Which question needs 7?

options.label: How many packs are needed so every pencil is packed?
options.feedback: Correct — the 5 leftover pencils still need a pack, so the partial group rounds UP to 7.

options.label: How many FULL packs are there?
options.feedback: That is 6 — full packs ignore the leftover entirely.

options.label: How many pencils are left over?
options.feedback: That is 5, the remainder itself, not a count of packs.

options.label: How many pencils in each pack?
options.feedback: That is 8, the divisor — it was given, not computed.

widget.prompt: Divide 257 by 7. The quotient is 36. What is the remainder?

commonErrors.feedback: A remainder can never reach the divisor — 7 more would make one more whole group.
36 is how many full groups formed; the remainder is what is left over after them.

takeaways: The remainder's meaning depends on the question.
Full groups, leftover, or rounded up.
